prompt.project_info: Atmospheric Japanese photobook-style film portrait adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original East Asian woman with long tousled dark waves, pale warm-toned skin, soft facial structure and minimal makeup; wearing a dark structured jacket or textured blazer, turning over her shoulder with a quiet contemplative expression.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level profile-through-obstruction composition, blurred translucent foreground layers and reflections, cluttered workshop/storage room or old bookstore with wooden shelves, papers and boxes behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour sunlight streams from the left, creating strong hair rim light, volumetric dust motes, lens flare, soft glare and dramatic light-shadow contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Shallow depth of field, sharp eyes, soft-focus lens character, visible analog grain, gentle bloom and cinematic film color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Atmospheric Japanese photobook-style film portrait of a clearly adult original East Asian woman with long tousled dark waves and minimal makeup, wearing a dark structured jacket, turning over her shoulder in a cluttered old bookstore or workshop, photographed through blurred translucent foreground layers, golden-hour window backlight, glowing hair rim, floating dust, lens flare, shallow focus, soft bloom and nostalgic analog grain.
